target_findings.exact_defect: Active profile references could not be resolved to supplied profile records or definitions inside validation scope.
target_findings.semantic_change: Every active profile resolves by exact profile type/id/version through the closed R4 package inventory; no latest/default/ambient lookup is permitted.
target_findings.residual_limitation: A future implementation must still perform standards-conformant schema validation; R4 supplies the contract inventory but no validator executable.

target_findings.exact_defect: Generic bundle content selected by schema ID/version had no complete in-scope structural schema-contract registry.
target_findings.semantic_change: Normative record content is admitted only after schema ID/version resolves to one closed package schema contract and validates structurally.
target_findings.residual_limitation: Generic JSON remains an untrusted content carrier until the referenced package schema contract validates it.

target_findings.exact_defect: Role visibility fields accepted strings outside the declared role vocabulary.
target_findings.semantic_change: Producing and consumer roles are closed to the package vocabulary; unknown roles fail before visibility decisions.
target_findings.residual_limitation: Future roles require a new explicitly versioned package/profile.

target_findings.exact_defect: Scenario-ID opacity was asserted as a boolean rather than bounded as a generation and semantic-use requirement.
target_findings.semantic_change: Scenario IDs are correlation-only, non-authoritative, non-evidentiary, and forbidden as baseline/classifier/verifier semantic predictors; generation must not encode expected outcomes.
target_findings.residual_limitation: The requirement does not cryptographically prove opacity of an arbitrary identifier value.

target_findings.exact_defect: Digest canonicalization was not fixed for every generic bundle-content form.
target_findings.semantic_change: A supplied digest requires an exact resolvable canonicalization profile that admits the schema/type and algorithm/method; absent or incompatible profiles cannot be silently bypassed.
target_findings.residual_limitation: The package uses RFC 8785 JCS and SHA-256 for the declared bundle-content form; other forms require a later explicitly versioned package contract.
